methods.name: Eight-positive zero-marginal trade forces equal-weight four-bit parity
methods.input_contract: Nonzero finite auxiliary signed X6 array with all raw three-axis marginals zero and exactly eight positive support sites.
methods.output_contract: Exactly eight negative sites and common absolute weight, with the source-defined four-bit parity form and allowed constant/repeated/complemented columns.
methods.core_law: Equality in the support lower bound forces the Boolean parity trade structure, including exact rational weights.
methods.hard_boundary: Closes the eight-positive/at-least-nine-negative or delete-light-point route. Does not prove the unrestricted best stability constant equals one.

reuse_resolution.how_applied_or_why_not: The declared raw marginal kernel and the owner support/slicing lemmas carry the proof. T4 finite-fiber capacity/minima is a coverage comparison and is not an invoked theorem.
reuse_resolution.hard_boundary_checked: No capacity-family attribution from vocabulary alone; source proofs retain positive BRC versus auxiliary signed-array typing.

result_scope.input: Nonzero finite post-aggregation auxiliary signed raw X6 array in one common chart, all 20 three-axis marginals zero, exactly eight positive spatial support sites; weights are positive on each Jordan side.
result_scope.conclusion: Exactly eight negative sites; all sixteen nonzero coefficients have one common absolute weight. Four represented independent binary coordinate types carry the parity sign. Every physical coordinate is constant or a repeated/complemented one-bit coordinate, with arbitrary distinct integer endpoint dictionaries.
result_scope.delete_one_positive_atom_ratio: 15/20 = 3/4; its positive-mass share before deletion is 1/8

existing_main_support_bridge.implication: For finite rational arrays, p(f)<2^k implies ||f||_1<=C(n,k)*D_(n,k)(f) with finite C. A nonzero zero-defect array therefore has p(f)>=2^k; apply to -f for negative support.
existing_main_support_bridge.base_case: At order zero, total zero and nonzero array imply at least one site of each sign.
